'''Cormium crystal''' was a valuable type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] that was among the relics included in [[Museum/Legends|museums]] aboard the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'' and the [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']].<ref name="The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cormium crystal was first introduced in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where a shard of crystal is involved in acquiring the Datacrons on the Republic and Imperial Fleets.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
